basis.actual: provider-billed teacher $ (measured tokens x configured price) plus the router's own embedding $; student serving cost NOT included (pending H1)
basis.saved: teacher_only - actual over requests_in_savings; an upper bound while the student cost is pending H1
basis.teacher_only: per request: the teacher's actual cost when it answered; else the teacher price x (estimated prompt tokens + the mean teacher output length: this gateway's logged teacher answers, else measured pipeline teacher calls). A request with no measured length is EXCLUDED from actual/teacher_only/saved and counted in requests_excluded; the basis of each row is in gateway_calls.counterfactual_basis

window: all logged skill requests since this gateway's call log began
